settingsAccountHint: your username stays with this account

atomicHandleBody: people will find you by it. pick one you’ll want to keep

recentBody: tap a name to send to them again

shellUnavailable: couldn’t set up offline mode. online everything works
shellOffline: no connection. you can look around, but signing in, opening and sending need internet

homeMakeBody: put something together just for them
authBody: use the account the postcard was sent to
phaseAuthenticated: signed in. confirm with your passkey to continue
scanWaiting: the photo never leaves your device

chooseHandle: pick a username. it stays with your account

cameraUnavailable: the camera isn’t available right now
